title: A simpler place for good food & friends
question: Choose a starting direction. Every option keeps reviewer selection and makes logging a meal the main task. Mockup meals are illustrative.

options.label: The meal ticket
options.lineage: The small ticket you fill in at a neighborhood lunch counter
options.thesis: Choose your name, pick a place, leave a score. One small ticket, then back to your friends.
materials: quiet rules and a clear review ticket
options.viewport: A compact wordmark, five reviewer choices, one large meal form, and a small recent-review list.
options.risk: The ticket has personality; too much decoration would slow down the simple form.

raised.raise: Keep reviewer, place, and score in a stable, immediately scannable order.
Give every screen one clear purpose and a consistent visual system.
Let one cheerful color carry the page while the form stays calm.
Reserve the strongest accent for saving a review.
Keep the current task dominant and its next action within reach.
Make the sequence easy to read without relying on explanatory text.

options.label: The shared notebook
options.lineage: A shared notebook passed around the dinner table
options.thesis: A warm food journal with a short review composer and your friends’ latest notes underneath.
options.viewport: A friendly greeting and reviewer strip above an open review composer, with a few recent notes below.
options.risk: The journal layout is familiar; its character depends on thoughtful typography and small details.

options.label: Departure board
options.thesis: Fixed columns make meals scannable, but a station board feels impersonal and adds visual density.
options.case: Fixed columns make meals scannable, but a station board feels impersonal and adds visual density.
options.viewport: An alternate structure evaluated against fast meal logging.
options.risk: Less familiar for a small group sharing food reviews.

options.label: Record catalog
options.thesis: Catalog numbers and coded labels obscure the simple task of reviewing dinner.
options.case: Catalog numbers and coded labels obscure the simple task of reviewing dinner.
options.viewport: An alternate structure evaluated against fast meal logging.
options.risk: Less familiar for a small group sharing food reviews.

options.label: Garden map
options.thesis: Bright regions can feel welcoming, but animated map shapes compete with the review form.
options.case: Bright regions can feel welcoming, but animated map shapes compete with the review form.
options.kept: One joyful color with a calm task area.
options.viewport: An alternate structure evaluated against fast meal logging.
options.risk: Less familiar for a small group sharing food reviews.

options.label: Monochrome product site
options.thesis: A claim-and-screenshot sequence explains a product; friends need to use it immediately.
options.case: A claim-and-screenshot sequence explains a product; friends need to use it immediately.
options.viewport: An alternate structure evaluated against fast meal logging.
options.risk: Less familiar for a small group sharing food reviews.

options.label: Vertical media feed
options.thesis: A photo-led full-screen feed depends on media the current journal does not collect.
options.case: A photo-led full-screen feed depends on media the current journal does not collect.
options.kept: One dominant task at a time.
options.viewport: An alternate structure evaluated against fast meal logging.
options.risk: Less familiar for a small group sharing food reviews.

options.label: Dance notation
options.thesis: An unfamiliar upward-reading score makes a quick meal entry harder to understand.
options.case: An unfamiliar upward-reading score makes a quick meal entry harder to understand.
options.viewport: An alternate structure evaluated against fast meal logging.
options.risk: Less familiar for a small group sharing food reviews.

canonCard.label: Keep it clean
canonCard.thesis: A familiar, quiet app with a compact form, clear labels, and one green save button.
canonCard.viewport: Reviewer chips, a simple review form, recent activity, and straightforward bottom navigation.
canonCard.risk: The least distinctive option, with personality carried mainly by the words and friends’ reviews.
